title: autoaliasattr_directive¶
content:
autoaliasattr_directive¶

A directive for documenting type aliases and other module-level attributes.

Classes

AliasAttrDocumenter

Directive which replaces Sphinx's Autosummary for module-level attributes: instead, it manually crafts a new "Type Aliases" section, where all the module-level attributes which are explicitly annotated asTypeAliasare considered as such, for their use all around the Manim docs.
